svg.text: claudia composes — the table of contents
Proposal for review — nothing is built (E9.31). A generated paragraph that stores only its options; its entries are derived from the headings, so there is nothing to update.
Insert ▸ Table of Contents (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I) put a “Contents” paragraph and the table at the caret, as one step. The pointer is over the table.
“Contents” is an ordinary paragraph in the style Contents Title:
its words are the author’s, and it has no outline level, so
the table does not list itself.
Each entry is a link to its heading (Enter or click). No page
numbers here: Flow view has no pages.
The entries are not text. Typing into the table is refused; the
caret steps over it; Enter before or after makes a paragraph;
Backspace selects it, a second Backspace deletes it.
A new heading, a retyped heading, a moved section: the entry
changes for everybody at once, without “Update”.
The look is styles: Contents 1 … Contents 9 (D306). The table
